image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing on a display stand in an indoor setting. The armor includes a helmet, breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist armor), gauntlets, and greaves (leg armor). The breastplate is the central focus, featuring a smooth, reflective surface with anatomical contours. To the left and right foreground, parts of other armor pieces or shields are visible. In the background, there is a wooden cabinet and a framed picture on the wall.

The fingers of the gauntlets lack distinct articulation plates. They appear as smooth, fused blobs rather than segmented metal fingers, which is a common AI artifact in complex mechanical structures.
The horizontal lames (strips) of the fauld show slight inconsistency in thickness and parallelism, suggesting minor geometric warping typical of generative models.
